keyFindings.description: The note prints Legion's defaultResources numbers as this deployment's standing budgets, and the deployment changed both before this head was written. Ephemeral storage: 'Each container of an issue pod is held to 1 GiB ... on this deployment' holds for five roles, but the implementer - the role every eviction event named - has had request = limit 4Gi since agent-infra #79 went live at 2026-10-20T22:30Z (dispatch://INFRA-51/comment/bf8035e7-9c34-4dcd-b3d7-4b787f815a1a: 'raises only the implementer's ephemeral storage: request and limit go to 4Gi. The other five roles stay at 1Gi'). Memory: the paragraph answering round 1 states 1Gi for architect/planner/merger, 4Gi reviewer, 6Gi implementer/tester, which is defaultResources and golden/root.json; this deployment replaced all six at 22:50Z with 512Mi architect/planner/merger, 4Gi implementer, 3Gi tester, 1536Mi reviewer (dispatch://INFRA-51/comment/a9f52454-8972-41ef-aa39-a161af45f020, proven there on a replaced pod). So the note's closing clause 'on a 1Gi role that is a smaller budget than the disk it was avoiding' understates the hazard by half, and a reader sizing a write off either number is wrong in both directions. This pod predates both applies ('the raise applies only to pods created after the apply'), so every in-pod figure the note carries is genuine for it - what is wrong is presenting the repository's defaults as what a reader's own container has. Fix by attributing: the defaults, what this pod carried when measured, and what the deployment sets now, with the two comments cited; the mechanism and the measurements stand unchanged.

roundOneFindings.reviewerCorrection: Round 1's second finding cited /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.current as its instrument. That path does not exist here - this sandbox is cgroup v1 (ls /sys/fs/cgroup gives cpu, cpuacct, cpuset, devices, job, memory, pids; find finds no memory.current) and the round-1 command fell through to memory/memory.usage_in_bytes, which is the sandbox's counter (memory.limit_in_bytes 20,401,094,656 bytes = free -k's total 19,922,944 KiB), not the container's. The hazard stood; the instrument named did not. Corrected in the PR body, in the round-1 inline comment, and recorded here, superseding the citation in review.json at commit 568499f7.
